data.name: Swaying Word
data.description: Once per day you may speak a word of divinely inspired wisdom that causes a single creature to switch its alliance to you. The target must be within line of sight and able to hear you. If he fails his Will save (DC %1), he is affected by dominate person, except the duration is only 1 minute.|SwayingWordDC
